REGULAR MEETING OF

AZUSA LIGHT & WATER
729 N. AZUSA AVENUE
AZUSA, CA 91702

06:30 P.M.
AZUSA UTILITY BOARD
EDWARD J. ALVAREZ
CHAIRPERSON

06:30 P.M. Convene to Regular Meeting of the Azusa Utility Board
Call to Order
Pledge to the Flag
Roll Call
A.
PUBLIC PARTICIPATION
(Person/Group shall be allowed to speak without interruption up to five (5) minutes maximum time, subject to compliance with applicable meeting rules. Questions to the speaker or responses to the speaker's
questions or comments shall be handled after the speaker has completed his/her comments. Public Participation will be limited to sixty (60) minutes time.)
B.
UTILITIES DIRECTOR COMMENTS
C.
UTILITY BOARD MEMBER COMMENTS
D.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
None
E.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Regular Utility Board Meeting on July 23, 2019 Recommendation: 1) Approve Minutes as Written.
E-1.1. Minutes of the Regular Utility Board Meeting on July 22, 2019
2.
Approval of the Notice of Completion for Capital Improvement Project W-351 Sunset Avenue Water Main Replacement Recommendation: 1) Accept Sunset Avenue Water Main Replacement project improvements outlined in W-351 plans and specifications; 2) Approve the Notice of Completion; 3) Authorize the Mayor to execute the document on behalf of the City; and 4) Authorize the City Clerk to submit the Notice of Completion for recordation to the Office of the County Recorder of Los Angeles County, within ten days of the Utility Board approval, as required by Section 3093 of the California Civil Code.
E-2.1. Approve the NOC for CIP W-351 Sunset Ave Water Main Replacement
E-2.2. NOC for Sunset W-351
3.
Approve Sole Source Purchase Order with Haaker Equipment Company for Water Division Vactor Truck Repair Recommendation: 1) Approve a sole source Purchase Order to Haaker Equipment Company, under Municipal Code Sec. 2-520(b)(2), in an amount not-to-exceed $37,163.79.
E-3.1. Approve Sole Source PO with Haaker Equipment Company for Water Division Vactor Truck Repair
E-3.2. Haaker Parts & Service Cost Estimate
E-3.3. Sole source Letter for Haaker Equipment Company
4.
Approve Memorandum of Understanding Between the Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County, The Los Angeles County Department Of Public Works and the City of Azusa with Respect to the Repair and Improvement of a Portion of Glendora Ridge Motorway Recommendation: 1) Approve a Memorandum of Understanding between the Consolidated Fire Protection District of Los Angeles County, the Los Angeles County Department of Public Works, and the City of Azusa; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the Memorandum of Understanding in behalf of the City of Azusa.
E-4.1. Approve MOU Between District, DPW, and Azusa for Glendora Ridge Motorway
E-4.2. Glendora Ridge Motorway MOU
E-4.3. Exhibit A
E-4.4. Western Water Works Supply Company Quote No. 545709-00
5.
Award Engineering, Inspection, and Commissioning Professional Contract to Electric Power Systems, Inc. for the Addition of a Medium Voltage Circuit Breaker on the South Bus of the Azusa Substation Recommendation: 1) Award a PSA contract to Electric Power Systems, Inc. in a total not-to-exceed amount of $49,999, for the engineering, inspection, and commission services in accordance with Scope of Work specified in RFP for project L-2019CB; and 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute, the Professional Service Agreement in a form acceptable to the City Attorney, on behalf of the City
E-5.1. Award contract to EPS for Addition of Medium Voltage Circuit Breaker
E-5.2. EPS Proposal
E-5.3. PSA - Electric Power Systems
F.
STAFF REPORTS/COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Fiscal Year 2018-2019 Fourth Quarter Budget Reports for Electric and Water Funds Recommendation: 1) Receive and file Fiscal Year 2018-19 Fourth Quarter Budget Reports for Electric and Water fund.
F-1.1 Fiscal Year 2018-19 4th Qtr Budget Reports for Electric and Water Funds
F-1.2 Fiscal Year End Water Utility Operating Budget Report
F-1.3 Fiscal Year End Electric Utility Operating Budget Report
2.
Results of the California Air Resources Boards August 2019 Auction of Greenhouse Gas Allowances Recommendation: 1) Receive and file Staff’s report on results of the August 20, 2019 GHG Allowance auction.
F-2.1. Results of August 20, 2019 GHG Allowance Auction
G.
VERBAL COMMUNICATIONS
1.
Power Supply Update
2.
Water Supply Update
3.
General Policy and Regulatory Updates
H.
CLOSED SESSION
1.
None.
I.
ADJOURNMENT
1.
Adjournment.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk at 626-812-5229. Notification three (3) working days prior to the meeting or time when special services are needed will assist staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide access to the meeting.
